name: Library (Ironforge)
summary: Tucked inside the eastern wing of the Hall of Explorers, the Library serves as Ironforge's foremost repository of historical knowledge, archeological relics, and ancient lore. Maintained diligently by the Explorers' League, it houses extensive historical tomes alongside rare artifacts recovered from digs across Azeroth.

sections.title: Heart of the Explorers' League
sections.body: Occupying a massive chamber within the Hall of Explorers, the Library is where dwarven scholars sift through the relics and field reports recovered by adventurers across the world. Administered by the Explorers' League, the shelves are packed with foundational chronicles detailing the War of the Three Hammers, the ancient Troll Wars, and the origins of the dwarven race. Inquiries regarding rare books or archival locations are directed to Librarian Mae Paledust.

sections.title: The Museum Displays
sections.body: Beyond rows of dense bookshelves, the Library doubles as a working museum overseen by Curator Thorius. Here, physical specimens collected from deep excavations, abandoned ruins, and distant shorelines are analyzed, preserved, and displayed. The League's curators preserve everything from crude murloc idols and carved knives to mysterious relics recovered frozen in northern ice, cataloging each find to piece together the hidden history of the Titans and early Azeroth.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Library in Ironforge?
faq.answer: It serves as the main research archive and museum for the Explorers' League. League members bring recovered artifacts, tomes, and field notes here to be cataloged, deciphered, and preserved for the dwarven people and the Alliance.

The Library's written collections and archival searches are assisted by Librarian Mae Paledust, while the museum wing and its physical historical artifacts are curated and maintained by Curator Thorius.

faq.q: What kind of books can be read here?
faq.answer: The Library contains foundational histories covering ancient and modern events, including the Old Gods, the Dragonflights, the Troll Wars, the War of the Three Hammers, the Rise of the Horde, and the formation of the Alliance of Lordaeron.

faq.q: Where in Ironforge is the Library located?
faq.answer: The Library occupies the eastern wing of the Hall of Explorers, situated in the northeastern quadrant of Ironforge.

angles.text: For dwarves, this hall represents King Magni Bronzebeard's push to uncover their Titan origins, housing the very accounts of the Awakening and the War of the Three Hammers.
The Library is an invaluable strategic archive for the Alliance, preserving crucial records from the Alliance of Lordaeron and eyewitness reports from the Second and Third Wars.
